name: initscript-nginx
description: Install nginx (apt or dnf/yum) and serve a page identifying the node; needs inbound 80 (e.g. sgTemplateId sg-usecase-web)

scripts.script:
#!/bin/bash # Installs nginx and serves a page that identifies this node. SITE_TITLE comes from env. set -e if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq >/dev/null apt-get install -y -qq nginx >/dev/null WEB_ROOT=/var/www/html elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then (dnf install -y -q nginx || yum install -y -q nginx) >/dev/null WEB_ROOT=/usr/share/nginx/html else echo "unsupported package manager"; exit 2 fi rm -f "$WEB_ROOT"/index.nginx-debian.html "$WEB_ROOT"/index.html cat > "$WEB_ROOT/index.html" < ${SITE_TITLE:-Cloud-Barista}

${SITE_TITLE:-Cloud-Barista}

Served by ${TB_NODE_ID} (${TB_NODEGROUP_ID} of infra ${TB_INFRA_ID})

${TB_CSP} / ${TB_REGION} · host $(hostname) · booted $(date -u +%FT%TZ)

Provisioned by CB-Tumblebug initScript.

EOF systemctl enable --now nginx >/dev/null 2>&1 || service nginx start systemctl restart nginx >/dev/null 2>&1 || service nginx restart curl -sf http://127.0.0.1/ | grep -q "$TB_NODE_ID" echo "nginx ready on $(hostname)"
